findings.title: Enrichment cancel/inFlight can permanently skip fetch (fail-open)
findings.problem: Effect cleanup sets cancelled=true while inFlight still holds the id; remount/successor effect skips fetch because inFlight.has(id), then finally clears the lock without re-running because pendingIds is unchanged. fileAttachmentEnabled stays undefined → treated as allowed.
findings.impact: A disabled assistant can keep Attach/paste/drop enabled for the whole session after a Strict Mode remount or chat switch race.
findings.recommendation: Use a module-level or chat-scoped inFlight/cache keyed by assistant id; on cancel do not leave pendingIds stuck without retry; or clear inFlight before bail and force a retry token when cancelled.

findings.title: Paste listener keeps stale addFiles after attachments disabled
findings.problem: useFilePaste registers handlePaste once via setupPasteHandler and closes over the first onFilePaste. Enrichment later flips canAttachFiles to false and swaps the prop, but Quill paste is never rebound.
findings.impact: Non-image paste can still call the original addFiles after the paperclip is hidden.
findings.recommendation: Keep onFilePaste in a ref updated each render, or re-register/remove the paste listener when canAttachFiles changes; add a regression test.

findings.title: Queued files still sendable after attach becomes disabled
findings.problem: Gating hides controls and no-ops new adds, but does not clear files state or block submit when canAttachFiles becomes false after enrichment.
findings.impact: Files added in the fail-open window (or before flag resolves) can still be submitted with the chat request.
findings.recommendation: When canAttachFiles flips to false, clear files (and optionally block canSubmit if any fileIds remain); add a unit assertion.
